text: {"assertions":["A wrong environment bug was found and fixed in platform/config/loader.py on 2026-02-12.","The bug only manifested for payloads larger than approximately two megabytes.","The bug's symptom was a production endpoint appearing in a staging process.","The root cause was two writes in the config loader that were not wrapped in a transaction.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction, implemented in PR #2146 on the fix/wrong-environment-1 branch.","The bug could be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","The backlog cleared 40 minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
